subject.title: fix(agent): exit nonzero when gateway runs do not complete

question: Should gateway timeout, error, and cancelled terminal responses now be a nonzero CLI exit contract for existing shell and CI callers?
rationale: The reported behavior is misleading for automation, but changing an existing command’s exit status is an intentional compatibility decision that tests alone cannot make on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Adopt the failure exit contract
options.body: Accept nonzero exits for gateway timeout, error, and cancellation after fresh current-head runtime proof confirms successful terminal controls still exit zero.

options.title: Preserve exit compatibility
options.body: Keep the current exit behavior and limit any repair to a documented structured result contract if maintainers do not want existing scripts to branch on failure exits.

recommendation.title: Adopt the failure exit contract
recommendation.body: Accept nonzero exits for gateway timeout, error, and cancellation after fresh current-head runtime proof confirms successful terminal controls still exit zero.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main history pass is needed to identify the owner of the gateway terminal-outcome and CLI contract.
